# Could AI replace digital-tagging in company sustainability reporting?

[Blog](https://wikirate.medium.com/could-ai-replace-digital-tagging-in-company-sustainability-reporting-4c8cfec50bc6) by WikiRate: “As artificial intelligence becomes increasingly commonplace, it is being presented as a solution for a broad swathe of tasks across different sectors. Company sustainability reporting is one example, which will be mandatory for companies operating in the EU with a turnover above €450 million and 1,000+ employees from 2027.

The European Sustainability Reporting Standards (ESRS) require companies to report digitally tagged data about their impact on the environment for the first time, helping data users understand companies’ exposure to risk and their effects on people and the planet.

However, a [recent discussion paper](https://www.dai.de/en/detail/why-ixbrl-reporting-requirements-should-be-removed) from an organisation representing some of Germany’s largest companies argues that the digital tagging¹ of sustainability data is too costly and that AI should take over this task.

But could and should we use AI alone to digitally tag companies’ sustainability reports?

**What is Digital-Tagging and why is it important for data users?**

In the [US](https://www.sec.gov/data-research/structured-data/inline-xbrl) and the [EU](https://www.esma.europa.eu/issuer-disclosure/electronic-reporting), it is already standard practice for financial reporting data to be digitally tagged. The practice means hundreds of data points can be easily identified and quickly compared. Think of it like adding a footnote or reference to an essay. When a tag is added to a data point in a report, that point is added to a reference list, making it searchable, downloadable and comparable across companies.

Digital tagging will soon be extended to companies’ sustainability data reported under the [ESRS](https://accountancyeurope.eu/publications/omnibus-explained-key-changes-to-the-csrd-and-csddd/). The sustainability standards will inform data users, including investors, governments, and the public, how well they understand and respond to risk. For example, green transition plans, supply chain grievance mechanisms, and workforce data demonstrate a company’s preparedness for environmental or human rights based risks. This information is crucial for enabling investors, policymakers, and consumers to make informed decisions regarding companies.

However, this development has not been universally welcomed, and some companies are [arguing](https://www.dai.de/fileadmin/user_upload/250905_Aktieninstitut_Position_on_iXBRL_Tagging.pdf) that “AI makes iXBRL [digital tagging] reporting increasingly obsolete. […] Given the significant costs and risks for issuers and the lack of added value for investors the only meaningful consequence would be to abolish ESEF/iXBRL reporting requirements entirely.”..([More](https://wikirate.medium.com/could-ai-replace-digital-tagging-in-company-sustainability-reporting-4c8cfec50bc6))”

# AI 能否取代企業永續報告中的數位標記？

WikiRate 的[部落格](https://wikirate.medium.com/could-ai-replace-digital-tagging-in-company-sustainability-reporting-4c8cfec50bc6)：「隨著人工智慧日益普及，它被包裝成能解決不同產業廣泛任務的方案。企業永續報告就是其中一例；自 2027 年起，在歐盟營運、營業額超過 4.5 億歐元且員工達 1,000 人以上的公司，都將被強制要求提交。

歐洲永續報告準則（European Sustainability Reporting Standards, ESRS）首次要求公司以數位標記資料，揭露其對環境的影響，協助資料使用者了解公司面臨的風險暴露，以及公司對人類與地球造成的影響。

然而，一個代表德國部分最大企業的組織在[近期討論文件](https://www.dai.de/en/detail/why-ixbrl-reporting-requirements-should-be-removed)中主張，永續資料的數位標記¹成本過高，AI 應該接手這項任務。

但我們能不能、又該不該只用 AI 來為公司的永續報告做數位標記？

**什麼是數位標記？它為何對資料使用者重要？**

在[美國](https://www.sec.gov/data-research/structured-data/inline-xbrl)與[歐盟](https://www.esma.europa.eu/issuer-disclosure/electronic-reporting)，財務報告資料進行數位標記已經是標準做法。這種做法代表數百個資料點可以被輕易識別並快速比較。可以把它想成是在一篇文章中加入註腳或參考資料。當報告中的某個資料點被加上標記，該資料點就會被加入參考清單，使其能夠被搜尋、下載，並在不同公司之間進行比較。

數位標記很快也會擴及企業依據 [ESRS](https://accountancyeurope.eu/publications/omnibus-explained-key-changes-to-the-csrd-and-csddd/) 申報的永續資料。這些永續標準將讓投資人、政府與社會大眾等資料使用者了解，企業對風險的理解與因應程度。例如，綠色轉型計畫、供應鏈申訴機制與人力資料，都能展現企業面對環境或人權相關風險的準備程度。這些資訊對於讓投資人、政策制定者與消費者能針對企業做出知情決策至關重要。

然而，這項發展並未受到所有人歡迎；有些企業正在[主張](https://www.dai.de/fileadmin/user_upload/250905_Aktieninstitut_Position_on_iXBRL_Tagging.pdf)：「AI 讓 iXBRL［數位標記］報告越來越過時。……考量到發行人承擔的重大成本與風險，以及對投資人缺乏附加價值，唯一有意義的結果就是完全廢除 ESEF/iXBRL 報告要求。」..（[更多](https://wikirate.medium.com/could-ai-replace-digital-tagging-in-company-sustainability-reporting-4c8cfec50bc6))」
